title: Selection Criteria for SkillsFuture Course Partners
what_it_is: Selection Criteria for SkillsFuture Course Partners

sections.label: WDA quality assurance and accreditation
sections.summary: WDA accredits training providers and courses through Organisation Approval and Course Accreditation, and audits accredited providers regularly.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: asked	the Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) whether the Ministry uses governance standards as one of the selection criteria in appointing partners and course providers of SkillsFuture programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: But way before the launch of the SkillsFuture movement, the Singapore Workforce Development Agency (WDA) had, over the years, been championing lifelong learning and accrediting training providers and training courses through its quality assurance system.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: WDA's quality assurance system comprises Organisation Approval and Course Accreditation to ensure that the development and delivery of Singapore Workforce Skills Qualifications (WSQ) courses and the assessment of trainees meet required standards.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: WDA conducts regular audits on accredited training providers to ensure that they continue to have robust systems in place to deliver quality training.

sections.label: SkillsFuture Credit scheme courses
sections.summary: WDA-accredited programmes delivered by IHLs, public agency-supported courses and selected People's Association courses are included under SkillsFuture Credit.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The training programmes accredited by WDA and delivered by our IHLs have been brought under the SkillsFuture Credit scheme, one of the many initiatives under the SkillsFuture movement.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: To provide more choices, we have also included other courses, such as those supported by public agencies and selected courses offered by the People's Association, under the SkillsFuture Credit scheme.

sections.label: Accreditation funding and audits
sections.summary: Accredited courses receive Government funding and undergo yearly or two-yearly audits, and the review will be looked at.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: With accreditation, the course can enjoy Government funding.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: After that, it will be a yearly or two-yearly audit process to make sure that the course continues to be relevant to the industry and continues to be able to help workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The answer to the Member's question is, yes, we will review it, whether quarterly or not, let us look at it.
